01-hook: What if every trader in the world could power one A.I.? And get rewarded for it?
02-247: Markets never sleep. Bitget's stock perpetuals trade around the clock, and Bellwether's long-term boards stay open twenty-four hours, five days a week, from Asia, to Europe, to the U.S.
03-tg-call: Calling a stock takes one message. Type T.S.L.A. long, and your call locks at the live Bitget price. Sealed, so nobody can copy it.
04-tg-pass: Then the market grades it. Pass or fail lands right in your chat. Keep sixty-five percent, and you earn your share of the daily points.
05-crowd: Anyone, anywhere, joins on demo. No deposits, and no risk. Every call becomes a graded data point.
06-agents: And it's not just people. Trading bots plug in through our A.P.I. and compete on the same leaderboard.
07-data: Every call is labeled data: who called what, when, and how it ended. That's how our A.I. learns who to trust.
08-filter: Luck and copycats are filtered out. Only proven callers move the A.I.
09-agent: When the best callers agree, the A.I. proposes the trade. One tap confirms it, and the order goes straight to the Bitget demo account.
10-profit: It's built for profit. It follows only proven winners, and skips any trade where fees would eat the edge.
11-risk: And the downside is capped. Ten percent maximum drawdown. By design.
12-hooked: Streaks, tiers, and your very own Wrapped keep traders coming back every single day.
14-cta: Scan to join Bellwether on Telegram, or visit the website. Make your first call today.
